subject: COVID-19 Mask Policy and Vaccine Clinics
overview: Superintendent Marice Edouard-Vincent updated the committee on the district's COVID-19 mask policy and announced upcoming vaccination clinics.

items.title: Superintendent's Report
items.summary: Superintendent Edouard-Vincent expressed support for Ukraine and confirmed the district's mask mandate remains in place until March 14th. Free vaccine and flu clinics are scheduled for March 2nd and 9th at Medford High School.
